title: 1RB1LE_0RC---_1RD0LA_1RE0RB_0LA0LF_0LD1LF: the walls are a base-4 odometer, followed exactly to 10^1520 steps
text: The walls between the blocks of 100 are the digits of a base-4 odometer (1010, 0, 1110, 1; merged walls (1010)r are digits too) that every trip from the right end counts up by one; the digit changes are proved in Lean for every block length (lean/Odometer.lean, 24 theorems), and they give the drain rates 4, 12, 48, 192, … per visit of the left end. An exact macro on them, checked against direct simulation to 5·1010 steps, ran from blank tape through 8,776 visits of the left end to step 6.4·101520 with no halt. The first block ran out at visits 22, 35, 37, 437 and 445 and was then 32,316 words, counting down by 4 per visit; its next run-out came as predicted at visit 8,516 (step 2.3·101476) and folded like the earlier ones; the next block, 106,032 words, now counts down.
